person.name: MD. Zeaul Hoque Zihad
person.headline: Full-stack developer. AI-integrated web applications.

statements.lead: I run a real fashion store in Baraiyarhat, and I wrote the software it runs on.
I build with AI in the loop: Claude Code, Cursor, the Claude and Gemini APIs.
Fourth year CSE at UIU. Graduating October 2027.

person.education: B.Sc. in CSE, United International University, Dhaka. Expected October 2027.
person.stack: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, SQL / React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Hono, FastAPI, Spring Boot / MySQL, TiDB, Cloudflare D1 / Git, GitHub, Cloudflare, Cloudinary, n8n / Claude and Gemini APIs, Ollama

projects.title: Big Bazar Baraiyarhat
bullets: Online fashion shop with 130+ products, shopping cart, and custom checkout (COD, bKash, bank transfer).
Custom admin panel with role-based access control, login rate limiting, and order fulfillment workflows.
Engineered inventory sync to stop overselling; completed full hosting and database infrastructure migrations.

projects.title: Shadow Palette: Stealth & Siege
bullets: 3D multiplayer strategy game where players construct fortified bases and raid enemy installations.
Engineered REST backend utilizing State, Factory, Strategy, and Observer design patterns.
Built and deployed as an Advanced Object-Oriented Programming (AOOP) team course capstone.

projects.title: BigBazar AI Messenger Sales Agent
bullets: Automated sales agent on Facebook Messenger: answers product inquiries, records advance payments, and issues receipts.
Architected to handle peak traffic of 10,000 to 40,000 incoming customer messages on busy retail days.
Integrated n8n automated replies across Messenger and Instagram, plus Gemini API for product recognition from video reels.

projects.title: AlgoMind
bullets: Step-by-step interactive visualization of BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, A*, Bellman-Ford, and Kruskal algorithms.
AI tutor powered by Claude API generating contextual hints, real-time code explanations, and dynamic quizzes.
Developed as a team project for the Artificial Intelligence Laboratory at UIU.

projects.title: MuteSound
bullets: Lightweight Chrome extension that silences active browser audio during prayer Azan time.
In active daily personal use; native cross-platform application version currently in development.
Built strictly for personal daily workflow; unpublished.
